description: Of a field's runways, each on the end the wind favours, the least crosswind, steady or gust, whichever is more: the runway a pilot would pick to keep the wind most nearly down it. A variable wind is all crosswind (AIM 7-1-28); calm is none. null with no wind or no runway end with a heading.

variation_deg.description: The field's magnetic variation, east positive, to turn a runway's number true where its end has no true heading.

end.description: The end it is on, null for a variable wind or calm.

crosswind_kt.description: Knots, unsigned, steady or gust whichever is more, unrounded (to a millionth of a knot), so the map's arrow is judged against the demonstrated crosswind on the crosswind itself, not whole knots (AV-10).
